definitions.gloss: allied nation; ally; member state of an alliance
definitions.explanation: A country that is part of a formal alliance, especially a military or political one.

examples.japanese: {同盟国|どうめいこく}と{協力|きょうりょく}する。
{日本|にほん}はアメリカの{重要|じゅうよう}な{同盟国|どうめいこく}である。
examples.english: Japan is an important ally of the United States.

examples.japanese: {首脳会談|しゅのうかいだん}では、{同盟国|どうめいこく}との{連携|れんけい}{強化|きょうか}が{主要|しゅよう}な{議題|ぎだい}となった。
examples.english: At the summit, strengthening cooperation with allied nations was a major agenda item.

notes:
A compound of {同盟|どうめい} (alliance) and {国|こく} (country). Frequently appears in news coverage of international relations, diplomacy, and security policy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同盟国|どうめいこく}との{関係|かんけい}: relations with allied nations
- {同盟国|どうめいこく}を{支援|しえん}する: to support an ally
- {主要|しゅよう}{同盟国|どうめいこく}: major ally
- {同盟国|どうめいこく}に{対|たい}する{義務|ぎむ}: obligations to allies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {友好国|ゆうこうこく}: friendly nation — countries with good relations but not necessarily a formal alliance
- {同盟|どうめい}: alliance — the alliance itself, not the member country
- {連合国|れんごうこく}: allied powers — historically refers to the Allied Powers in the World Wars
- {加盟国|かめいこく}: member state — a country belonging to an organization like the UN
